coverage: TAR, tar.gz/tgz, tar.bz2/tbz2, tar.xz/txz, tar.zst/tzst registry/create/extract/convert
strict actual ZIP expansion in ordinary archive and nested secret-scan consumers
controls_note: Case counts overlap across runtimes and layers; these are not live acceptance counts.
preserved: original input bytes and failure observations
source identity checks, cancellation and atomic new-copy publication
unknown postpublication effects without automatic replay

limits.tar_records: strict USTAR with bounded local PAX paths; links/devices/sparse unsupported
limits.single_stream: exactly one complete stream; embedded header filenames ignored
